# physical place

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:physicalPlace`](gmeow-physicalPlace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/physicalPlace>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
